verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a first-party REST API that can reach any existing object in an account and returns standard JSON, so data can be pulled out in an open format. There is no documented bulk export or offboarding path, so completeness of export is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk full-account export, an explicit guarantee that all data (evidence files, policies, audit history) is exportable, documented offboarding/data-portability terms, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Secureframe API utilizes resource-oriented endpoints and returns requests in the form of standard JSON responses, based on the JSON API spec.
Use Secureframe’s API to connect to any existing object in your Secureframe account.
The Secureframe MCP server allows you to access and manage your Secureframe data — controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, risks, and more — as Model Context Protocol tools.
